$comment: Job schedules (01 §5.6, D-38). The deploy turns this into pg_cron jobs named familywise-<name> (scripts/job-schedules.mjs) and into private.job_schedule rows for job_health. Cron times are UTC. HTTP jobs call /api/jobs/<name in kebab-case> and each owns its minutes: no two HTTP jobs share a minute (schedule.test.ts). SQL jobs run inside the database.

jobs.name: heartbeat
jobs.purpose: Sample job: proves pg_cron, pg_net, the job endpoint and job_run end to end, and reports scheduling lag.

jobs.name: occurrence_gen
jobs.purpose: Keeps each household's chores and tasks planned 14 days ahead (WP-09); edits re-plan at once in the database.

jobs.name: day_close
jobs.purpose: Finalizes each household's past routines once its local day has ended: those not done become missed; tasks carry over (WP-10).

jobs.name: status_check
jobs.purpose: Nightly: re-folds the last 14 days of completion events and fails if any stored status differs from them (WP-10, NFR-06).

jobs.name: progress_reconcile
jobs.purpose: Evaluates each household's goals that need it with the rules engine (marked dirty, due to start or end, or not yet evaluated today) and applies their status changes once (WP-19).

jobs.name: reminders
jobs.purpose: Every 5 minutes: plans the reminders that have come due and sends those due now by web push, each at most once, held through quiet hours (WP-40, D-58).

jobs.name: calendar_sync
jobs.purpose: Every 15 minutes (minutes 3, 18, 33, 48): fetches each household's published calendars that are due, expands them over the window (a week back, 120 days ahead) and stores their events; a broken link keeps its last good events (WP-22, D-63).

jobs.name: weather
jobs.purpose: Every 30 minutes (minutes 9 and 39): reads the temperature now and today's high and low at each household's place from Open-Meteo and stores it for the boards; a read that fails is recorded and the boards stop showing the weather (WP-45, D-69).

jobs.name: purge_history
jobs.purpose: Keeps history small: pg_cron run details 7 days, job_run 90 days, app_error 30 days, wrong pairing codes 1 day.
jobs.sql: delete from cron.job_run_details where end_time < now() - interval '7 days'; delete from public.job_run where started_at < now() - interval '90 days'; delete from private.app_error where occurred_at < now() - interval '30 days'; delete from private.pairing_failure where at < now() - interval '1 day';
